CVE-2026-133244.title: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross- ...
CVE-2026-133244.description: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

CVE-2026-133245.title: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-133245.description: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.
